item.title: Mailday 0.1.13 · build 14
item.description:
Mailday 0.1.13 · build 14
- Smaller account badges and tighter desktop sidebar spacing. - Drag accounts into order on Mac, or use Move up/down in Settings → Accounts. Option/Alt + Up/Down also works on a focused sidebar account. The order is saved on this device. - Connecting an account now shows a live elapsed timer and the current check. - A clear “Account connected” confirmation appears as soon as the account is saved. The first mail download has its own progress and can be stopped without disconnecting the account. - Connection success and errors stay visible below the form on Mac, iPhone and iPad.
Account ordering does not sync between devices. Touch targets remain large on iPhone and iPad. Server and first-download duration still depends on the provider and mailbox size.
